unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is an authorized caller of addRewards or claimRewards, so the actor/authorization scope of the scenario is unspecified.
Report does not specify concrete amounts or numeric bounds for the reward accounting increase, so no numeric accounting relation can be bound.

Token theft is described only as a potential outcome combined with other unspecified weaknesses; the report gives no concrete observable extraction relation, so the impact is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome rather than a numeric transfer relation.

limitations: The impact is potential and conditional on combination with other unspecified weaknesses; the plan does not assert inevitable token theft.
The ordering property is represented as a Boolean ordering observable because the report states the ordering requirement qualitatively without concrete step values.
Actor authorization for addRewards/claimRewards is not established by the report; the scenario is kept at the report-stated level.
